links.comparator_used: Same 20 questions posed with no prompt directive (default prompt), versus a directive to simplify language
links.outcome: Readability/complexity of responses versus expert-rated comprehensiveness, helpfulness and accuracy
links.effect: Simplification prompt reduced complexity (DouBao readability age 12.9 ± 0.8 to 10.1 ± 1.2 years, p < 0.01). Comprehensiveness (p = 0.03) and helpfulness (p < 0.01) declined significantly post-prompt, particularly for DouBao (accuracy: 57.5% vs. 7.5%, p < 0.01).
links.tradeoff: Simpler language came with reduced comprehensiveness and helpfulness and lower rated accuracy (notably DouBao), risking compromised clinical relevance.
links.quote: While simplifying language improves readability, it risks compromising clinical relevance.

design_hint: prompt engineering for simplified reading level
